# JobCompass — UK job search, done properly
> Agentic CV tailoring — A4 GBP British spelling, per-bullet field locks, two-pass hallucination audit (DeepSeek + Claude Haiku), DID ground truth, Companies House trust 80/20, Cloudflare D1/R2/Queue/Vectorize. Credits never expire £0.10/app.

## What it does
- Registry → tailor → validate → quickVerify → patched → verifier → corrective → persist → matcher → HITL → PDF → apply
- No hallucination: field locks per exp.0.bullet.2, confidence cap 70 without DID, atomic credits

## Pages
- / — hero + pipeline + calculator
- /how-it-works — 12 stages
- /pricing — Starter £10/100 Active £25/250 Power £50/500
- /uk-advantage, /security, /jobs, /companies, /docs, /blog, /status

## API
- POST /auth/request-code, /auth/verify-code (PIN SHA-256 KV TTL600)
- POST /resumes/:id/tailor (routeChat tailor DeepSeek)
- GET /jobs, /jobs/library, /companies (public)
